findings.summary: The export materializes a projected 1,807,231 rows and passes all of them to a single worksheet, exceeding Excel's 1,048,576-row worksheet limit by 758,655 rows. The declared EXCEL_MAX_ROWS constant is never enforced, so the default export can fail, truncate data, or produce an invalid/incomplete workbook instead of remaining downloadable within worksheet capacity.

unverified: Browser memory and runtime feasibility cannot be verified; nested flatMap/map constructs materialize the full expanded row array before workbook generation.
No tests or error handling are shown for worksheet-capacity boundaries, workbook-generation failures, or download failures.

The supplied diff does not show how Lot is defined/imported or how writeSingleBrowserWorksheet is implemented, so compilation and writer behavior (including any implicit truncation) cannot be verified.
No reconciliation mechanism is shown to detect or report omitted, duplicated, or truncated export records.

findings.summary: displayedClosing subtracts only expense and fx_eur consumption, omitting the supported fx_other category. Given the observed fx_other total of 1494440 TRY, the displayed closing balance is overstated by exactly 1494440 TRY and cannot reconcile for all supported consumption types.

unverified: The supplied diff does not show any display of the required exact TRY opening, inflow, per-category outflow, conversion, and closing turnover, so full presentation/specification compliance cannot be verified.
No tests are supplied to verify reconciliation, TRY precision/rounding behavior, empty or malformed consumption handling, or the definitions and type compatibility of Pool and sum.

findings.summary: Each detail amount is rounded independently, with no residual-cent reconciliation, so the exported details are not guaranteed to sum to the currency-rounded source amount; the supplied evidence reports 1578 TRY aggregate drift.
The function neither validates nor normalizes shares to ensure they sum to 1, so even before rounding, incomplete or excessive shares can produce a total different from the source.

unverified: No tests are shown for exact-cent reconciliation, negative amounts, zero or empty shares, malformed shares, or large allocations.
The required behavior for invalid/non-finite source values and shares is unspecified and cannot be verified from the diff.
Whether binary floating-point arithmetic remains stable across the repository's supported amount ranges and currencies is unverified.

findings.summary: The verify script no longer runs `prisma generate`, so generated clients are not refreshed before typecheck despite the schema adding `newcrmChangedSince`.

The `|| echo existing Prisma mismatch` fallback converts every `tsc --noEmit` failure into a successful exit, including unrelated TypeScript errors, so typecheck is not a truthful non-zero release gate.
A temporary reviewer-only probe is added to the release tree, directly violating the requirement to ship only product and durable public methodology artifacts.
Private review-run scratch notes are added to the release tree, directly violating the acceptance criterion excluding private root-cause scratch material.

unverified: Operational feasibility, scale behavior, reconciliation, numerical stability, generated-artifact freshness, error handling, security, and tests cannot be verified from the supplied two-file diff.
